I would recommend buying the stand to go with ($90) but super easy to pack up.  I’ve been able to take to parks and beaches.  I also love that the grill is easy to clean.  Would be nice if Weber advertised on the website all the accessories that work for this grill.  I found Home Depot website a little easier to find exact accessories for this grill. Results.ReviewText: My wife and I just got back into camping.  We bought a travel trailer and I decided not to mess with charcoal while RVing any more because it's a mess.  So I bought another popular brand of portable gas grill first because it was cheaper than a Weber.  That turned out to be a mistake because the second time I went to use it the grates were rusted!!  I've owned several Weber products in the past and currently have a Performer Kettle, so I know they're quality grills.  So I decided to bite the bullet and buy the Weber Q1200.  Initially I looked at the Q1000 because of the lower price but I liked the wing tables on the Q1200.  I also liked that I could get it in my favorite color blue.  The Q2000 is nice too but with just my wife and I it was bigger than we need and takes up more storage room.  Now after using the Q1200 twice I love it.  The heat is nice and even and the food gets a nice smoky grilled flavor.  It's doesn't get too hot and never flares up.  Cleanup couldn't be easier.  The two cast porcelain enamel grate halves pop right out and can be soaked in a dish pan or RV sink for cleaning.   The interior is easy to get to and can be wiped out with a paper towel.  And there are foil liners for the drip pan that can just be tossed. I also like the wing tables as you can just set it on a picnic table and have a place to put cooking tools, etc. without setting them on the table.  In the end I'm glad I spent the extra money and got the weber.
Results.Title: Perfect for Rving!
